author: Travis Chinn
title: Spirit Lake celebrates Hometown Heroes on Wednesday night - NewsBreak
text:
By Travis Chinn ,
1 days ago
SPIRIT LAKE , Iowa ( KCAU ) — Folks in Spirit Lake got a chance to meet some first responders and business leaders Wednesday night at Spirit Lake Elementary School.
The family-friendly event, called “Hometown Heroes,” is put on by the Spirit Lake Chamber of Commerce.
Businesses set up booths with games for kids.
Story continues below
The Spirit Lake Police Department, fire department, linemen from Iowa Lakes Electric, and city workers were on hand to meet folks and let kids explore the different vehicles present for the event.
It’s all to celebrate the Spirit Lake community.
“It’s just a fun evening to come out and see everything our community has to offer, from businesses to some of the large vehicles. We have a DNR boat here, so things that kids and families might see around, but they can see it all in one place tonight,” said Krista Smith, Executive Director of the Spirit Lake Chamber of Commerce.
Hometown Heroes went from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. There were also food trucks on hand if attendees got hungry.
